decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, so the firm has made little public commitment, but the investment already made in a several-model maritime line and the long naval procurement cycles let weak early sales be read as temporary, so management keeps it.

The medical examination light builds on the established offer, has its own website page and fits the energy-efficient LED direction, so the visible commitment and sunk development cost favor persisting.

The explosion-proof industrial line has several certified models, involved heavy certification investment, sits at the core of the firm's industrial focus and is publicly presented, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The designer task light was publicly announced as a relaunch of a popular product, is close to the core offer and has its own page, so earlier commitment and established demand support keeping it.
